`tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py` now rounds half-up. I haven't run it or any tests.

It was a `NotImplementedError` stub, so I implemented it. It multiplies the line amount in cents by the rate using `Decimal` and rounds to whole cents with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. It returns an integer number of cents, as the project's money convention requires.

I also updated the stored "Tax rounding rule" memory. It said banker's rounding and "never half-up", and your instruction supersedes that. The rule to round each line's tax separately and then sum, never rounding the invoice total, is unchanged.
